name: vwap_slope_momentum_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY's session VWAP sustains an elevated linear-regression slope (z-score > 1.5 persisting 25+ seconds), it reflects active institutional TWAP execution — large buy-side desks slicing directional orders into the NIFTY futures book, weighted by volume. NIFTY futures market makers continuously quote against VWAP benchmarks, so a persistently steep VWAP slope forces their delta-hedging in the same direction, amplifying the initial institutional push and creating short-term price momentum at the index level. The 5-bar persistence requirement (25 seconds at 5s bars) filters NIFTY's inherent single-candle noise and confirms the slope is institutionally sustained — we enter as that flow continues and ride the 30-90 second continuation.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP slope z-score above 1.5 sigma (vs 20-minute baseline) sustained for 5 consecutive bars (25 seconds), confirming active institutional TWAP execution in progress
